status.current_name: FUSATI ENGENHARIA E ASSESSORIA AMBIENTAL LTDA
status.scope_reason: The company designs, manufactures, and sells custom reverse osmosis systems for industrial, laboratory, and commercial applications.
status.evidence: According to the official website of the company's brand, FUSATI Ambiental custom-designs and manufactures automated reverse osmosis systems to separate dissolved salts and impurities for industrial use.

claims.claim: The company reports that its reverse osmosis stations are integrated systems composed of membranes that serve as physical barriers to remove dissolved salts and organic/inorganic molecules from water, as detailed on the official FUSATI website.

claims.parameter: Revenue & Growth in Brazilian RO Market
claims.claim: The company reports offering custom-engineered Reverse Osmosis (RO) systems, specifically mentioning its specialized Reverse Osmosis Station Model ROH featuring a 1.5 m³/h capacity for physical-chemical separation of dissolved solids, as documented by Asstefil.
claims.corrected: The company reports offering custom-engineered Reverse Osmosis (RO) systems, specifically mentioning its specialized Reverse Osmosis Station Model ROH featuring a 1.5 m³/h capacity for physical-chemical separation of dissolved solids, as documented by Asstefil.

claims.claim: The company reports providing customized water treatment and reverse osmosis solutions for domestic, industrial, and commercial client segments across Brazil, but it does not specify any named reverse osmosis system reference clients or strategic partnerships.

The company reports its own unified industrial base located at Rua Fernandópolis, 177, in Piracicaba, São Paulo, which serves as the central hub for its internal design, custom engineering, and own manufacturing of modular reverse osmosis and water filtration stations, as detailed on the FUSATI Contact Page.
